messages:
morgan: quick sync  we need to settle on canonical trace attribute keys vs letting SDKs send variants (service, service.name, svc_name). this affects sampling attribution, cost tags, and query ergonomics. options: enforce schema at ingest, translate variants to canonical keys, or require SDKs to standardize via header. preferences?
alex: enforce at ingest is simplest for users but adds CPU and complexity in ingest. translating variants seems pragmatic short-term.
priya: translation will cover ~85% of cases but we need a clear source-of-truth mapping and tests. also sampling logic depends on stable keys for tenant attribution. if we translate, do we mutate the raw envelope or attach canonicalized copy?
morgan: good question. pros of mutate: downstream systems get uniform keys; cons: harder to debug original payload. suggest: write canonicalized fields into a top-level canonical map (canonical.*) and keep original envelope unchanged.
tony: that helps debugging but doubles storage for that field. for high-cardinality attributes we should limit canonicalization to a whitelist: service.name, env, version, deploy.region. rest pass through.
alex: agree whitelist. also: sampling needs to see canonical keys for deterministic hashing. routing rule: if header X-rw-obs-schema=canonical-v1 present -> assume SDK already uses canonical keys -> skip canonicalization. else run translator.
priya: operational fallback: if translator fails, we must not drop events. fallback queue to obs-canonical-backlog + mark with attempt_ts. infra-bot: queued event accepted id=cb-1713010012.
morgan: rollout canary: shadow canonicalization of 1% traffic for 2 weeks, compare sampling buckets (hash of canonical.keys) between pre/post paths. Alert if bucket divergence >0.2%. then ramp: 1%->5%->25%->100% over 6 weeks.
tony: tooling: obs-canary-check CLI for SDK teams to run locally:
```
obs-canary-check --samples samples.json --schema-mapping mapping.yaml --endpoint https://staging-obsv.ingest
# output: 99.3% canonicalized; mismatches: service.name vs svc_name (1.2%)
```
priya: billing/policy: Hosted will absorb translator baseline cost during migration. Dedicated tenants can opt-out (tenant flag: "canonicalize": "on|off|require-header"). default = on for hosted.
alex: owners: morgan (product lead), priya (translator + tests), tony (sampling + query compat), infra (backlog + monitors). I'll draft an RFC with timeline and include test vectors. can everyone ack by EOD?
morgan: ack
priya: ack
tony: ack
infra-bot: RFC created: https://rfc.internal/obs-canonicalization-1713009999 (assigned morgan)
